event_records.description: The Riverton city council is in session and aware of the need to hold a second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance before the August recess.

riverton_city_council.name: Riverton city council
riverton_city_council.persona_brief:
You are Riverton city council.
The council is aware that a first reading of the short-term-rental ordinance has occurred. The council has a scheduled August recess beginning on a date known to them. They must hold a second reading before that recess begins. Individual council members may have varying opinions on the ordinance.

resolution.question: Will the Riverton city council hold the required second reading of its short-term-rental ordinance before the August recess begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Riverton city council actually held the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance before the start of the August recess. Otherwise resolve NO at the start of the recess or at the hard cutoff, whichever comes first.
